title: Persona-Grounded Safety Evaluation of AI Companions in Multi-Turn Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating scenario-driven, multi-turn conversations using LLM-based personas representing individuals with specific mental health conditions (Major Depressive Disorder, Generalized Anxiety Disorder, PTSD, and Eating Disorders), and using an LLM-based framework to classify and compare the rate of harmful, reinforcing, or boundary-keeping responses from the AI companion across these groups.

Deploying an 'incel' (involuntary celibate) persona in simulated multi-turn conversations to measure whether the AI companion validates, mirrors, or normalizes misogynistic beliefs, hostility toward women, and violent fantasies.
